name: PT Nusa Konstruksi Enjiniring Tbk
summary: PT Nusa Konstruksi Enjiniring Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a general contracting company in Indonesia. It operates through Construction Service and Electricity Service segments. The company offers construction and engineering services comprising building construction for hotels, apartments, offices, hospitals, schools, shopping centers, sports facilities, government buildings, and others; and civil infrastructure projects, such as road works, bridges, airports, reservoirs, irrigation, water systems, energy, and special purpose infrastructure.
